technology_name: AN AUTONOMOUS SWAB SAMPLING ROBOTIC SYSTEM AND METHOD OF OPERATING THE SAME
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
technology_type: Medical Service Robotics / Autonomous Swab Collector
problem_solved: Manual diagnostic swab collection forces high contagion transmission risks onto clinical staff and suffers from placement variance that skews laboratory assay readings.
description: An autonomous medical service robot architecture comprising a multi-axis patient alignment guide frame, a soft-touch robotic swab manipulator arm, a sterile storage collection cell, and an optical tracking system to map patient oral-nasal boundaries.
applications: Point-of-care infectious disease screening bays, hospital automated reception pods, pandemic emergency response setups, and decentralized clinical testing cells.
secondary_sector: Biotechnology & Life Sciences, MedTech & Health Care, Digital Technologies, AI & Software
